The '''1968–69 Cypriot First Division''' was the 30th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Olympiakos Nicosia]] won the championship.  [[AEL Limassol]] participated in the [[1968–69 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in the 18th position.
